primary_endpoint: Number of participants with adverse events from first dose through week 48, with follow-up up to a maximum of 66 weeks.
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 5/50 with tropifexor 140 mg, 3/48 with CVC 150 mg, 4/47 with tropifexor 140 mcg plus CVC 150 mg, and 10/48 with tropifexor 90 mg plus CVC 150 mg; no deaths were reported.
